requirements.name: Authentication framework
requirements.description: The platform shall support pluggable authentication providers including passwordless, SSO, MFA, and enterprise identity federation.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: A tenant can configure approved providers and authentication policies without code changes.

requirements.name: Session management
requirements.description: The platform shall issue, refresh, revoke, and expire sessions with configurable risk and inactivity policies.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Revoked or expired sessions cannot access APIs or user interfaces.

requirements.name: Service identities
requirements.description: The platform shall support non-human identities for integrations, jobs, and AI agents.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Every service identity has explicit owner, scope, credentials, rotation, and audit history.

requirements.name: Authorization service
requirements.description: All protected platform actions shall use a centralized authorization decision service.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Every decision returns allow or deny, matched policy, effective scope, and correlation ID.

requirements.name: Device trust
requirements.description: The platform shall register device posture and support risk-based access controls.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Policy can require trusted devices for sensitive actions.

requirements.name: Tenant context propagation
requirements.description: Tenant context shall propagate through API, event, job, cache, search, file, and AI operations.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: No platform service may process a governed request without verified tenant context.

requirements.name: Tenant data isolation
requirements.description: All storage and query paths shall enforce tenant isolation.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Cross-tenant access attempts are blocked, logged, and testable.

requirements.name: Regional data placement
requirements.description: Tenants shall support region selection and data-residency constraints.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Configured regional placement is visible and enforced for governed data classes.

requirements.name: Provisioning automation
requirements.description: Tenant provisioning shall create required namespaces, defaults, indexes, storage, keys, and baseline configurations.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Provisioning produces a validation report and rollback plan.

requirements.name: Global identifier service
requirements.description: The platform shall provide globally unique, non-guessable, immutable identifiers for governed records.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Identifiers remain stable across versions, imports, exports, and integrations.

requirements.name: Metadata framework
requirements.description: Entities and fields shall support extensible metadata definitions without ungoverned schema changes.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Metadata is versioned, validated, permissioned, and queryable.

requirements.name: Universal tagging
requirements.description: Users and automation shall apply governed tags to supported objects.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Tags support ownership, scope, synonyms, lifecycle, and search.

requirements.name: File and document service
requirements.description: The platform shall store, version, classify, scan, preview, and secure files and documents.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Every file version has checksum, owner, classification, retention, and access policy.

requirements.name: Search service
requirements.description: The platform shall provide permission-aware full-text and structured search.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Search results never expose unauthorized records or snippets.

requirements.name: Notification service
requirements.description: The platform shall send in-app, email, SMS, push, and webhook notifications through governed templates and preferences.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Every notification has delivery status, retry, deduplication, and audit.

requirements.name: Scheduler service
requirements.description: The platform shall schedule one-time and recurring tasks with tenant-aware execution.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Schedules are versioned, observable, cancellable, and protected from duplicate execution.

requirements.name: Background job service
requirements.description: Long-running work shall execute through durable background jobs.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Jobs support priority, retry, idempotency, progress, cancellation, dead-letter handling, and audit.

requirements.name: Distributed cache
requirements.description: The platform shall provide a tenant-aware cache with explicit key ownership, TTL, invalidation, and fallback behavior.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Cache failure cannot corrupt source-of-truth data.

requirements.name: Configuration service
requirements.description: Runtime configuration shall be centrally resolved, versioned, validated, and auditable.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Services can read effective configuration and subscribe to approved changes.

requirements.name: Feature flag service
requirements.description: Capabilities shall support tenant, user, percentage, environment, and effective-date feature flags.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Feature rollout and rollback are controlled without redeployment.

requirements.name: Workflow engine
requirements.description: The platform shall orchestrate durable stateful workflows with timers, approvals, retries, and compensation.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Workflow state survives service restart and can be inspected.

requirements.name: Rules engine
requirements.description: The platform shall evaluate versioned deterministic rules against declared inputs.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Rule results are reproducible, explainable, and attributable to a rule version.

requirements.name: State machine framework
requirements.description: Governed entities shall support explicit state machines and allowed transitions.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Invalid transitions are blocked and valid transitions emit events.

requirements.name: Timer and SLA engine
requirements.description: Workflows shall support due dates, timers, escalation, pause, resume, and calendar-aware SLAs.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Timer behavior remains correct across time zones and downtime.

requirements.name: API gateway
requirements.description: External and internal APIs shall pass through a governed gateway.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: The gateway enforces authentication, authorization, versioning, throttling, request limits, and correlation.

requirements.name: API versioning
requirements.description: APIs shall use explicit versioning and deprecation policies.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Breaking changes require a new supported version and migration notice.

requirements.name: Webhook service
requirements.description: The platform shall publish signed, retryable, tenant-scoped webhooks.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Consumers can verify signature, replay protection, event ID, and delivery attempt.

requirements.name: Event bus
requirements.description: Platform domains shall publish durable versioned events through an event bus.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Events have schema, tenant, producer, timestamp, correlation, causation, and idempotency keys.

requirements.name: Connector framework
requirements.description: The platform shall support governed connectors with credentials, scopes, mappings, health, and sync state.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Connector actions are observable and independently disableable.

requirements.name: Import engine
requirements.description: The platform shall import structured data using mappings, validation, previews, errors, and resumable batches.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: No invalid row is silently accepted.

requirements.name: Export engine
requirements.description: The platform shall export authorized data to governed formats with filters and classification controls.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Exports record requester, criteria, file, checksum, retention, and expiration.

requirements.name: Mobile application shell
requirements.description: The platform shall provide a reusable mobile shell for field workflows.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: The shell supports secure login, navigation, camera, location, notifications, and local storage.

requirements.name: Offline data packs
requirements.description: Authorized users shall download scoped offline data packs for field work.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Offline packs are encrypted, time-limited, versioned, and revocable.

requirements.name: Offline transaction queue
requirements.description: Offline actions shall be queued locally with durable ordering and status.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Queued changes preserve original user, device, timestamp, and correlation.

requirements.name: Synchronization engine
requirements.description: The platform shall synchronize offline and online changes with deterministic conflict handling.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Sync results identify applied, rejected, merged, and manual-review changes.

requirements.name: Attachment synchronization
requirements.description: Files captured offline shall upload resumably with checksums and classification.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Duplicate or corrupt uploads are detected.

requirements.name: Structured logging
requirements.description: All services shall emit structured logs with tenant-safe correlation fields.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Logs exclude prohibited secrets and sensitive payloads by default.

requirements.name: Metrics and health
requirements.description: Services shall expose health, capacity, latency, error, and dependency metrics.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Health checks distinguish startup, readiness, liveness, and degraded state.

requirements.name: Distributed tracing
requirements.description: Requests, events, jobs, workflows, and AI actions shall support distributed tracing.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: A correlation can be followed across service boundaries.

requirements.name: Alerting framework
requirements.description: Operational thresholds shall create deduplicated alerts with ownership and escalation.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Alerts contain runbook, impact, severity, and supporting evidence.

requirements.name: Encryption in transit
requirements.description: All supported network communication shall use approved encrypted transport.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Insecure transport is rejected except isolated approved development environments.

requirements.name: Encryption at rest
requirements.description: Governed data shall be encrypted at rest with managed keys.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Key use, rotation, access, and failure are auditable.

requirements.name: Secrets management
requirements.description: Credentials and secrets shall be stored only in approved secret stores.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Secrets are never persisted in source code, ordinary logs, or user-visible configuration.

requirements.name: Malware and content scanning
requirements.description: Uploaded content shall be scanned and quarantined based on policy.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Unsafe content cannot be opened or distributed before disposition.

requirements.name: Backup and restore
requirements.description: The platform shall perform encrypted backups and tested restoration.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Restore tests prove stated recovery point and recovery time objectives.

requirements.name: Disaster recovery
requirements.description: Critical services shall have documented failover, recovery, and communication procedures.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Recovery exercises produce evidence and corrective actions.

requirements.name: Rate limiting and abuse control
requirements.description: The platform shall rate-limit and detect abusive API, login, export, and automation behavior.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Controls can be scoped and do not expose cross-tenant information.

requirements.name: Time zone framework
requirements.description: All timestamps shall be stored in UTC and rendered using declared user or project time zones.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Scheduling and due dates remain correct through daylight-saving transitions.

requirements.name: Unit framework
requirements.description: The platform shall support US customary and metric units with governed conversion and precision.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Every quantity stores value, unit, precision, and conversion provenance.

requirements.name: Currency framework
requirements.description: Monetary values shall store currency and support governed conversion rates where required.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: No arithmetic combines different currencies without an explicit conversion.

requirements.name: Language and locale
requirements.description: The platform shall support locale-aware text, numbers, dates, and translations.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Users can select supported locale without changing stored canonical values.

requirements.name: Model gateway
requirements.description: AI model calls shall pass through a governed model gateway.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: The gateway enforces model policy, tenant context, limits, logging, redaction, and fallback.

requirements.name: Agent registry
requirements.description: AI agents shall be registered with owner, purpose, version, permissions, tools, and evaluation status.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Unregistered or disabled agents cannot execute.

requirements.name: Tool execution service
requirements.description: AI tools shall execute through permissioned, validated, observable adapters.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Every tool invocation records input summary, output summary, result, duration, and correlation.

requirements.name: Prompt and policy registry
requirements.description: Prompts and AI policies shall be versioned, approved, testable, and rollbackable.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Production execution identifies exact prompt and policy versions.

requirements.name: Evidence and citation service
requirements.description: AI outputs shall attach source references and evidence where required.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Evidence remains resolvable to the authorized source version.

requirements.name: AI evaluation framework
requirements.description: Agents and prompts shall be evaluated for accuracy, safety, authorization, consistency, and business acceptance.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Failed release gates prevent promotion.

requirements.name: AI usage and cost metering
requirements.description: The platform shall meter AI requests, tokens, tools, latency, errors, and cost by tenant and capability.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Usage reports reconcile to gateway records.

requirements.name: Platform event audit
requirements.description: Material platform events shall be preserved in an immutable audit trail.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Events can be correlated to request, actor, service, object, and tenant.

requirements.name: Data portability
requirements.description: Authorized tenants shall export core data and attachments in documented formats.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Exports are complete, traceable, and do not include unauthorized shared data.
